WEDDING QUESTIONS

Start with
the details.

How many guests can the event space accommodate?+
The event space accommodates up to 150 people, with around 70 guests for a comfortable gathering. Your layout, furniture, and celebration plans affect how the space works; discuss these with the events team.
Can we reserve a wedding room block?+
Ask about a block of 9 or 18 guest rooms, subject to availability. The team will confirm allocation, payment arrangements, release dates, minimum stays, and any exclusivity in your agreement.
What food and bar arrangements are available?+
We offer event-space rental and private bar service. Discuss food arrangements, packages, staffing, and what is included for your date before booking suppliers.
How is an event inquiry confirmed?+
Prepare your event email on our contact page, then send it through your email app, or call the inn. Preparing a draft does not send it. Dates, guest rooms, price, and inclusions are confirmed through your agreement.
